source.build_method: Two clean unprivileged aarch64 builds from the recorded offline pmbootstrap cache: apk.static under a single-uid user namespace materialized the same 199-package Alpine edge build root (aarch64 install scripts and triggers cannot exec without binfmt; the busybox applet farm and abuild group were replayed inside the guest), then proot -0 with PROOT_NO_SECCOMP=1 translated child execs through qemu-aarch64 11.0.2-r1 and abuild 3.18.0_rc3-r1 ran with -F -d against the hash-locked local Weston tarball and four patches. Both runs used SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1785283200 and ABUILD_LAST_COMMIT=uncommitted-sixrow-modern-layout-r4.
source.signing_note: Both APKs were directly signed during abuild with the readable canonical P2-track key pmos@local-6a5d38f2, whose public key is committed at config/lmi-p2-d114/pmos@local-6a5d38f2.rsa.pub.

verification.unit_tests: 13 passed, 1 skipped across 14 tests (tests/lmi_weston_sixrow with the official tarball and local r4 APK present; the disabled r2 transient exact-stage fixture remains absent)
modern_layout_changes: Shift moved to the leftmost slot of the modifier row
shared bottom row carries always-available / : - . keys on both pages
backslash and pipe are adjacent and shift-paired on the symbol page
digit and bracket keys carry physical-keyboard shift pairs
